name: ORBCore refund-before-sell reentrancy with pair-reserve burnLP
summary: ORBToken forwards received BNB to ORBCore.addPoolAndSell, whose sell branch refunds the BNB before selling and then calls ORBToken.burnLP, burning pair ORB and syncing, unguarded. The attacker moved most pair ORB to Core with flash-loaned WBNB, re-entered at the refunds so 58 nested burnLP calls ground the reserve to dust, then sold for the pair's WBNB.
notes: ORBToken.setAddress(ORBCore) wired the token's receive() forwarding, the Core transfer exemption and burnLP/mint powers to this Core, after Core's deployment; the exploit needs that grant, so the token is a config-reset target and sets the age. Other wiring and minBNB, whiteListOpen and the sell/burn ratios were unchanged before the exploit.

WBNB depletion of the ORB/WBNB pair 0x64fad72e5dde70b2960497744b348fd64cb4788c across the transaction (45.318191861188781185 -> 0.335708357864918575), less the attacker's pre-held 3,483.438204554125976510 ORB valued at the pre-exploit reserve ratio (0.027093460559344606 WBNB). Sell taxes routed to leader2 are not deducted; borrowed legs are repaid in-transaction and excluded.
